scripts.dev: npm run build:web && wrangler dev --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.build: npm run build:web && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.jsonc --dry-run --outdir .build
scripts.deploy: npm run build:web && npm run db:migrate && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.jsonc --keep-vars
scripts.db:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config wrangler.jsonc

FILES.description: Private files and immutable versions in your own R2 bucket.

DB.description: Folder index, versions, and access rules in your own D1 database.

OWNER_EMAIL.description: Your Cloudflare Access sign-in email. Stored as a Worker secret, never committed.

ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN.description: Your https://TEAM.cloudflareaccess.com address. Complete Access setup after deployment.

ACCESS_AUD.description: Audience tag from your Access application, set after deployment.
